title: Jazz, Jazz
style: jazz, classic, jazz, tin pan alley
lyrics:
[Verse]
It don't matter
What mood I'm in
How loud I scream
Or how quiet I sing
I'll never get over you
It's classic

[Chorus]
Like jazz, jazz
The right amount of sad
Jazz, jazz
The good kind of bad
Jazz, jazz
You were the best I ever had
[Verse 2]
Do you remember?
All of those nights
Our favorite songs
And how we got 'em right?
I wish I could forget 'em
But I can't

[Chorus]
Jazz, jazz
The right amount of sad
Jazz, jazz
The good kind of bad
Jazz, jazz
You were the best I ever had

[Bridge]
But I can't forget
How you made me feel
And I won't forgive
Because it was too real

[Chorus]
Jazz, jazz
The right amount of sad
Jazz, jazz
The good kind of bad
Jazz, jazz
You were the best I ever had
Jazz, jazz
The right amount of sad
Jazz, jazz
The good kind of bad
Jazz, jazz
You were the best I ever had
